summary: Converts three float inputs a2[0..2] into int16 values using a 2048.0 scale with saturation at +/-15.999512, storing the results at this+0xC (this[6]), this+0xE (this[7]) and this+0x10 (this[8]). Each component is clamped to 0x7FFF when above 15.999512 and to -32767 when below -15.999512; in-range values are multiplied by 2048.0 and truncated to int16. Returns the third converted value.

local_names.a2: source float array of three components
local_names.comp2: component 2, stored at this+0x10 and returned
local_names.result: third converted value returned by the function

operations.description: Component 0 upper clamp: if a2[0] > 15.999512, this[0xC] = 0x7FFF.
Component 0 lower clamp: if a2[0] < -15.999512, this[0xC] = -32767.
Component 0 scale: this[0xC] = (int)(a2[0] * 2048.0), truncated to int16.
Component 1 upper clamp: if a2[1] > 15.999512, this[0xE] = 0x7FFF.
Component 1 lower clamp: if a2[1] < -15.999512, this[0xE] = -32767.
Component 1 scale: this[0xE] = (int)(a2[1] * 2048.0), truncated to int16.
Component 2 upper clamp: if a2[2] > 15.999512, this[0x10] = 0x7FFF and result = 0x7FFF.
Component 2 lower clamp: if a2[2] < -15.999512, this[0x10] = -32767 and result = -32767.
Component 2 scale: this[0x10] = (int)(a2[2] * 2048.0), truncated to int16; result = (int16)that value.
Return result, the third converted value.
